summary: SPK RC 49 sua do dai video luon hien 0:00 va lam ro chu tren khung dieu khien khi video co nen sang.
changes: Sua loi tat ca nguon deu hien do dai 0:00: qua trinh import goi thang 'ffprobe' nhung tren NAS chi co ffmpeg (CodecPack hoac ban static bundled), khong co ffprobe tren PATH -> probe that bai -> luu durationMs = 0. Gio tim ffprobe canh ffmpeg da resolve / bien moi truong FFPROBE_PATH / PATH; neu khong co thi tu doc metadata bang 'ffmpeg -i' (parse Duration, do phan giai, fps, codec tu stderr).
Backfill do dai cho nguon da import truoc ban va: khi mo lai danh sach nguon, moi nguon dang 0:00 se duoc probe lai (chi doc header, co cache) va cap nhat vao DB, nen khong can import lai.

Lam ro chu tren khung dieu khien review khi video co nen sang: them do bong chu (text-shadow) cho toan bo nhan noi, tang do dam cac nhan mo (timecode, ten canh, so frame) va lam manh nhe lop scrim tren/duoi — truoc day cac chu nay bi chim khi video nen trang.
Them test cho parseFfmpegProbeStderr (tach rieng phan doc metadata tu stderr ffmpeg).
